notes: Verified against oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/RenderStateProbe.java (the scene's opt object records rd, fov, gamma, bob, clouds=shouldRenderClouds(), tpv, ana, dbgcam, fancy) and Oracle.java's tape header (options object plus Oracle.opts). rs_in field usage verified in csrc/engine/renderstate.c for fov, gamma, rd and bob; tpv is consumed in raster_hand.c; ana and dbgcam have no consumer found. Grouped key binding fields are one entry because they differ only in description and key code; the clouds field appears twice because the method and the field are both public API. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): options are pinned in the tape header; nothing changes them mid-session. Formerly listed as missing: sendSettingsToServer's C15PacketClientSettings has no native send path (nothing changes settings mid-session in the recorded game, so no tape exercises it) particleSetting is recorded in the tape header but no native code consumes it to gate particle spawning ambientOcclusion has no native counterpart: the section meshes carry baked smooth lighting and the setting itself is never read mipmapLevels and anisotropicFiltering are not ported: raster_texture.c builds a fixed mip chain and samples GL_NEAREST regardless showDebugInfo is recorded by Oracle.opts but the native renderer draws no F3 debug screen anaglyph and debugCamEnable are carried in rs_in but no native consumer was found for either
